thread.title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Buy from Morgan Stanley

author: Ryan Adist
title: Apple (AAPL) Receives a Buy from Morgan Stanley
text:
Ryan Adist - January 3, 2019, 9:00 AM EDT SHARE ON:
In a report released today, Kathryn Huberty from Morgan Stanley maintained a Buy rating on Apple ( AAPL ), with a price target of $211 . The company’s shares closed yesterday at $157.92, close to its 52-week low of $146.59.
According to TipRanks.com , Huberty is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 9.2% and a 55.8% success rate. Huberty covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Pure Storage Inc, Seagate Tech, and NCR Corp.
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for Apple with a $196.17 average price target, which is a 24.2% upside from current levels. In a report issued on December 19, Jefferies also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $225 price target.

Based on Apple’s latest earnings release for the quarter ending September 30, the company reported a quarterly revenue of $62.68 billion and net profit of $14.13 billion. In comparison, last year the company earned revenue of $88.48 billion and had a net profit of $20.07 billion.
